Row 1 has two cards; row 2 has two cards; bottom has ONE full-width card, exactly like the approved screenshot. Card heights may naturally accommodate text, but keep the same overall two-row-plus-one-wide organization. No third rail, no three-column dashboard, no charts. Black / white / gray / pale blue only. Long Chinese buyer names wrap inside the cards, never clip.
